//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Village Spawn Point -> Config

Enable Village Spawn Point.//: Whether Village Spawn Point is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

locateVillageTag.//: The village structures to spawn in, separated by a comma. Structure tags work too, starting with a '#'.

keepDefaultVillageTagBackup.//: If a custom value was entered in 'locateVillageTag' and no spawn point can be found, use '#minecraft:village' as a fallback value.

blacklistedVillageStructures.//: Village structures that will never be used as the spawn point, separated by a comma. Structure tags work too, starting with a '#'.

maximumVillageSearchSeconds.//: How many seconds the mod may search for a village before using the default spawn point. min: 1, max: 3,600

spawnNewPlayersInsideUndergroundVillages.//: Whether new players are teleported into the village when it is underground.
